necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the diagnosis codes R55 and I49.5 despite the denial code CO-197.
